notes:
Based on Cartwheels Gym Centre's own programs page, here's what I found for parent & tot gymnastics in Halton Hills:

**Tiny Gym at Cartwheels Gym Centre** — 
this class is for the youngest gymnasts with their parent/caregiver, focusing on sensory and gross motor development, co-ordination, balance, strength, flexibility, social skills, and fun
. 
1-year-old participants are strongly recommended to be fully independently walking before the term begins
, and per their eligibility rules, kids stay in Tiny Gym 
until they are not yet three years plus six months prior to the term start date
 — so it covers roughly ages 1 to 3.5.

The catch: 
availability and pricing are only available by logging into their Registration Website, since pricing fluctuates term by term based on varying term lengths
. No fall day/time is posted on the public page.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Tiny Gym, Cartwheels Gym Centre",
      "age_fit": "Youngest gymnasts (walking 1-year-olds up to not-yet-3.5 years), with parent/caregiver",
      "source_name": "Cartwheels Gym Centre"
    }
  ]
}
```

I did not include Mini Gym since it's for children ready to participate without a parent, not a parent & tot format, and Tumble n' Learn is a drop-off preschool program — neither matches what was asked.
